newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yue Yuen completes US$210 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Yue Yuen completes US$210 mln loan.

text.p: Athletic shoemaker Yue Yuen Industrial (Holdings) Ltd has completed a five-year US$210 million dual-tranche term loan/revolving credit facility with 25 banks, bankers said on Thursday.
The facility consisted of a HK$1.085 billion term loan and a US$70 million revolving credit, they said.
The interest margin was 57 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate for the loan, and 55 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate for the revolving credit facility.
Citicorp International, Goldman Sachs Asia and IBJ Hong Kong are senior arrangers.
Proceeds of the facility would be used for working capital and to expand production.
